name: Reallusion iClone 8 · render-still
note: Load an iClone project (.iProject) or import a supported asset (.fbx/.obj), set camera + lights, render one still frame via RLPy. Requires iClone 8 running with the Python API plugin active.

rows.label: 1 load
rows.value: iClonepy.exe load_scene.py: open project or import asset into current scene

rows.label: 2 configure
rows.value: iClonepy.exe setup_render.py: set camera, resolution, lights, render settings

rows.label: 3 render
rows.value: iClonepy.exe render_still.py: RGlobal.RenderImage to output path

rows.label: 4 report
rows.value: node report.mjs: verify output image, record timing
